_about: Ethylbenzene (1) + p-Xylene (2): isobaric T-x-y at 100.65 kPa. Rows: liquid mole fraction of ethylbenzene, boiling temperature in K, vapour mole fraction of ethylbenzene, as stored in the ThermoML Archive record (mole fractions of the other component converted with x_1 = 1 - x_2).

source.citation: Rodrigues, W. L.[Willias L.], Mattedi, S.[Silvana], Abreu, J. C. N.[Joao C. N.], Vapor-Liquid Equilibria Data for Binary Systems of Ethylbenzene + Xylene Isomers at 100.65 kPa, J. Chem. Eng. Data 50 (2005) 1134-1138
source.access: The journal article may be subscription-only; the same data is public in the NIST TRC ThermoML Archive (NIST open license).
source.tables: ThermoML record, PureOrMixtureData 10, 11. The table number in the article was not checked.

notes: Read with validation/python/vle_batch.py. Consistency point test (Redlich-Kister fit to T-x): mean |dy| 0.0040. Pure-component boiling points of the set within 0.34 K of the vapour-pressure records. To be checked by a person against the record (AGENTS.md rule 4).
